adapter.workflow: no-tools completion from a prepared packet over SSE; the primary response grammar is canonical FILE/SEARCH/REPLACE or NEWFILE blocks. One adapter-side recovery may normalize a wholly explicit FILE:/SEARCH:/REPLACE: response for Ticket-allowed paths only; then the normal harness owns apply/gates.

do_not_use_when: the packet has unresolved design alternatives

telemetry.source: SSE usage event emitted by llama.cpp stream_options.include_usage

change_note: 1.0.2 makes the parser-owned response grammar explicit in the system instruction. It adds only a narrow recovery for a fully explicit, Ticket-allowed FILE:/SEARCH:/REPLACE: payload (optionally wrapped by one fence); it never infers a file path, accepts prose or a diff, or bypasses the standard patch applier and gates.
